name: Selesnyan Artifact
description: A Selesnyan artifact that appears in Miri's robe pocket and reveals Vitu-Ghazi's hidden weaknesses.

timeline.summary: At Vitu-Ghazi a mysterious artifact appears in Miri's pocket and reveals that the world tree is fragile and could be toppled.
timeline.quote: One well-targeted attack could bring the whole structure down, this time for good.
